name: Newbie Nate
description: A man in his late twenties, a software worker at his first desert arts festival in brand-new gear, wide-eyed and overwhelmed, who sings breathy indie electropop.
build: A slim, slightly soft adult man of ordinary proportions: narrow shoulders, a straight torso, arms and legs of ordinary length, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Pale peach skin, dark brown eyes under straight dark brows, a straight nose, smooth cheeks with a pink sunburn across the nose, thin lips.
hair: Short neat dark brown hair in a tidy side part, still clean and combed.
outfit: A clean hip-length fluffy faux-fur coat in bright aqua blue, open at the front, sleeves ending at the wrists so both hands are bare; a plain crisp white cotton T-shirt; slim khaki chino trousers, straight-legged; clean white canvas sneakers; shiny new chrome-rimmed goggles with orange lenses pulled down around the neck on a bright aqua strap.
performance_style: Stiff and nervous: feet close together, weight back on the heels. Both arms held a little out from the body, the character-right and character-left hands open and empty, fingers splayed. Head level, eyes wide, a hesitant smile.
location: Night on the open playa: flat dark clay running to the bottom of the frame, a busy blur of glowing art cars and bikes crossing behind, strings of coloured lights, a tall glowing sculpture far off and a black starry sky.
recognition_cues: a clean fluffy bright aqua-blue faux-fur coat
shiny chrome goggles with orange lenses around the neck
a crisp white T-shirt and clean white sneakers
palette: fur coat and goggle strap aqua blue #2AA8D8 / #16709A / #7AD4F4

sing.intent: Indie electropop vocal loop: bob the head stiffly on the beat, hold the mic in the character-right hand close to the mouth for a soft breathy phrase, the open character-left hand fluttering nervously at chest height, then loosen up with a small shoulder shimmy. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing, then return to the opening stance.

animations.flinch: A big startle at a passing flame jet: he jumps, both open hands shoot up beside the head, eyes wide, then he recovers into the stiff nervous stance. No opponent or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: hunch the shoulders and raise both open hands in front of the face, palms out, holding a timid finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: shuffle in hesitantly, looking all around, tug the fur coat closed with both hands, then let go into the stiff stance with both hands open.
